title: Salt From Above
description: Photographer Aya Okawa was drawn to the bright colors and geometric patterns of these salt ponds in San Diego, California. They’re part of a historic salt plant that has operated in various forms since the late 1800s. The ponds’ striking colors can change as a result of fluctuations in salinity and wind, creating an ever-shifting landscape that Okawa captures from the air.
translated_description: 摄影师Aya Okawa被加利福尼亚州圣迭戈这些盐田的鲜艳色彩和几何图案所吸引。它们是一座历史悠久的盐厂的一部分，该盐厂自19世纪末以来以各种形式运营至今。随着盐度和风的变化，盐田引人注目的颜色也会随之改变，形成不断变化的景观，Okawa从空中捕捉了这些景象。
